test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate answer to fill in blank 3.
solution: The correct answer is **embedding**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Embedding: **gerund or present participle of embed; to fix something firmly and deeply (in something else). (किसी वस्‍तु को (अन्‍य वस्‍तु में) मज़बूती से बैठाना, जड़ना) • The sentence implies that tattooing involves fixing a design of ink and colour into one's flesh. • Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3 is **option 2**. Correct Paragraph:__ *Tattooing is a talent that requires a lot of time and (1) __ability__. There are many various kinds and (2) __genres__ tattooing. Tattooing was and still is a means to communicate someone's thoughts or life by permanently **(3)** __**embedding**__* *a design of ink and colour into their flesh. The first step in tattooing is to develop an artistic (4) _______ and the skill to sketch and create your artwork. Tattooing penmanship is far more (5) _______ than sketching on paper.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Detaching: **gerund or present participle of detach; to separate something from something it is connected to. (किसी वस्‍तु को उससे अलग करना जिससे वह जुड़ी है, वियोजित करना) • **Combining: **gerund of present participle of combine; to join or mix two or more things together. (दो या अधिक वस्‍तुओं को जोड़ना या मिलाना) • **Fertilising: **gerund or present participle of fertilise; to put a male seed into an egg, a plant or a female animal so that a baby, fruit or a young animal starts to develop. (गर्भाधान करना; शुक्राणु या पुष्‍प-पराग प्रदान करना) 194:Tdcb, The correct answer is **attitude**.
